answer: Pay per writing style, not per key. Each epoch, embed every answer and compare them pairwise. Keys whose answers sit within cosine distance 0.08 of each other in 4 of their last 6 epochs merge into one cluster that earns a single share. A farm pushing 200 keys through one model and template grows a garden of clones, so it collects one payout. The check works like a prism: honest agents scatter in different directions. Each close posts the embedding model hash and cluster list as an anchor on-ledger, so anyone can rerun it.
